title: feat(rest): GET /data/:object/export?template=true answers an xlsx import template (#18386)
body:
Part of #18386. The objectui half is objectstack-ai/objectui#9600, not in this PR; the part of this card the PR leaves open is the write-permission narrowing of the column rule (see "Left open").

Clause-②: yes (widening)

`GET /api/v1/data/:object/export?template=true` answers an xlsx import template: the columns an import stores (the card's column rule, one exclusion per table row), `*` on required columns, one example row, dropdowns for select / radio / boolean, and an instructions sheet whose accepted-value text is built from the import reader's own spellings. Without `template=true` the export is byte-identical to its output at the branch point 6bff748bbd, pinned in `import-template-route.test.ts`.

Left open: the template narrows columns by the security service's READ projection (`getReadableFields`). The card's "FLS ∩ writable" needs a write-side field projection that `ISecurityService` does not carry today; adding one touches `packages/spec` and `plugin-security`, outside this claim's file surface.
